results.intentUsed: This page estimates shipping and discounts for a $42.00 cart. Work through these checks in order and record exactly what you observe for each: 1. Read the Subtotal, Shipping and Order total, then confirm the arithmetic: order total must equal subtotal minus any discount plus shipping. 2. Apply the promo code SAVE10 and check the Discount line equals exactly 10% of the SUBTOTAL (not of subtotal plus shipping) — state both numbers. 3. With SAVE10 still applied, apply an obviously invalid code such as NOTREAL; confirm the invalid-code error appears AND that the previous discount is removed rather than silently kept. 4. Select the Express tier and re-check that the order total updates consistently with the shipping price shown on that row. 5. Compare the FREE badge shown on a shipping row against the Shipping amount used in the totals — they must agree.
